tasks.title: Straight-up jump
tasks.instructions: Create a distinct straight-up airborne pose. Keep the body compact and legs beneath him; avoid the diagonal forward-reaching silhouette. Preserve the intended facing on a vertical jump. Start with one missing airborne frame, using existing takeoff and landing frames as onion references.

tasks.title: Straight-down drop
tasks.instructions: Create a distinct straight-down airborne pose with the feet prepared beneath the body. Preserve facing rather than implying a sideways leap or backwards motion. Start with one missing airborne frame; compare against existing descent preparation and landing crouch.

tasks.title: Look down from a perch
tasks.instructions: Lower the head to inspect a card or landing below. Keep the planted paw cells fixed and allow the body/tail to overhang. Use the sitting/perch frames as references.

tasks.title: Refine horizontal leap
tasks.instructions: Refine the approved AI horizontal flight pose. Keep a level back, forward head, trailing tail and gathered legs. Human pixel edits to the AI source make a mixed-origin frame; retain its lineage. No planted contact anchor while airborne.

tasks.title: Refine independent walk heads
tasks.instructions: Review the high/low head combinations. Improve the head/neck seam if needed while leaving leg frames and every planted paw marker unchanged. Compare original and half-time head bobbing at the same walking speed.

tasks.title: Sitting head glance
tasks.instructions: Explore a small head turn toward a nearby object without flipping the whole body. Audit the existing turn/idle catalogue before drawing new pixels; keep bearing paws in their source cells.
